name: cheque_lifecycle_integrity
preconditionSql: SELECT to_regclass('public.cheques') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public.financial_movements') IS NOT NULL AND to_regprocedure('public.fn_customer_advance_effective_applied(uuid)') IS NOT NULL AS ok;
verificationSql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname='bt_cheques__lifecycle' AND NOT tgisinternal) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname='ct_financial_movements__cheque_settlement_link' AND NOT tgisinternal) AND to_regprocedure('public.fn_cheque_lifecycle_guard()') IS NOT NULL AND to_regprocedure('public.fn_cheque_movement_deferred_link()') IS NOT NULL AS ok;
recovery: Transactional failure restores the pre-09.06 state. After success use forward-only migrations; do not rewrite migration 0032.
